listing.name: The Order: 1886 — The Order1886 native port (mateussmeneses) (mateussmeneses)
listing.summary: The project tested boot and the New Game prologue cutscene on an RTX 5060 Laptop. Save/load and the campaign are unverified. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own CUSA00035 version 01.02 dump containing eboot, sce_module and sce_sys. Other patch serials have not been tested.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Use the released runtime or build from source, then import your own dump. Game data is not included.

warnings: The project tested boot and the New Game prologue cutscene on an RTX 5060 Laptop. Save/load and the campaign are unverified.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
